title: Clamp load of two suppliers' bolts
intro: 20 bolts from supplier 1 and 35 from supplier 2 were tested for clamp load (kN). Supplier 1: mean 41.0, standard deviation 1.8. Supplier 2: mean 37.0, standard deviation 4.2. Different bolts, σ unknown, very different spreads: Welch's t. H₀: μ₁ − μ₂ = 0 against H₁: μ₁ − μ₂ ≠ 0 at α = 0.05.
